findings.message: Patient testimonial with none on file (FTC 16 CFR 465 risk).

findings.evidence: author.name: schema='Dr. Elena Marsh' vs post='Dr. Marcus Oyelaran'
findings.message: JSON-LD 'author.name' does not match the post.

findings.quote: "I was nervous about whitening, but my teeth are four shades brighter and I had no sensitivity at all," says Maria T., a recent patient.
findings.why: The ficha has no testimonials on file, so this quote and patient are invented, and it also implies a specific result with no sensitivity (FTC endorsement and ADA advertising risk).
findings.fix: Remove the quote and the named patient entirely.

findings.why: The visible byline and front matter name Dr. Marcus Oyelaran as author (Dr. Marsh is the reviewer), so the JSON-LD contradicts the visible text.
findings.fix: Set the JSON-LD author to Dr. Marcus Oyelaran and optionally add Dr. Elena Marsh as reviewer (reviewedBy).

findings.quote: In-office whitening at our practice is $395.
findings.why: The price matches the ficha, but it is stated without the context of what is included.
findings.fix: Optionally note that the price should be confirmed by calling the office.

findings.quote: Pregnancy or breastfeeding, where many dentists advise waiting.
findings.why: This is a common cautious recommendation but is not backed by a cited source.
findings.fix: Cite ADA guidance or phrase it as 'ask your dentist first'.

findings.quote: Sensitivity usually settles after treatment ends. If it does not, stop and call your dentist.
findings.why: The advice is sound, but the post could say more about what to do for persistent sensitivity or gum irritation.
findings.fix: Add that any persistent or severe pain or gum irritation warrants a dental visit.

findings.quote: Whitening is one of the most requested cosmetic treatments, and one of the most misunderstood.
findings.why: A harmless general statement with no source, and its phrasing is a mild AI-style rhetorical pairing.
findings.fix: Soften or cite a source, for example: 'Whitening is a popular cosmetic treatment.'

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: This demo disclaimer would be out of place on a real published post.
findings.fix: Keep it only for the demo context and remove it for any real publication.
